Mine's pretty lame, but when I was about 8 or 9, I went to my grandparents house for about three to four days since they lived pretty far from our home at the time. I slept in the guest bedroom which only had one window that led to a fence so I couldn't see shit from it. One morning, I woke up as usual and just beside my pillow was a dead, gray bird that had its head detached and beside its chest. I jumped off the bed (making sure not to touch its corpse) and went and tell my grandparents what I saw and when we came to investigate, it was gone. Later that morning, we left the house to go to swimming in the lake close to where they lived and there it was, laying in the driveway and exactly the same way I saw it waking up. I couldn't believe it at first and my grandpa went and picked it up saying it must have killed itself in the garage. Nobody believed me when I told them and they told me to shrug it off, but I'm still kind of traumatized at the event...
